hooks.name: Run codec tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the Vitest codec test suite whenever a file under /web/src/codec is saved and reports which of the message-codec Properties 1-16 pass.

action.prompt: A file under /web/src/codec was just saved. Run the codec test suite with: cd web && npx vitest run src/codec --reporter=verbose 2>&1. Then report: (1) overall pass/fail; (2) pass/fail for each message-codec property, using the names in the suite: Property 1 to Property 13 in message.properties.test.ts (Property 4 runs as two tests, 4a and 4b), Property 14 (tests 'false-accept m=4' and 'false-accept m=3') and Property 15 (tests 'random-input m=4' and 'random-input m=3') in message.measure.test.ts, and Property 16 (Format_Document vector conformance) in message.vectors.test.ts; (3) any type errors (run cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p .) or import violations (codec importing from UI or camera APIs, checked by message.isolation.test.ts). Keep the report short: one line per property, then a brief summary.
